village.name: Village Square
village.description: A quiet village square. Snow has begun to fall, and the villagers look worriedly at the frozen sky.

cave-entrance.name: Volcanic Cave Entrance
cave-entrance.description: A heavy stone door covers the volcanic cave entrance, emitting a faint warmth. It is locked.

map.name: Scout's Map
map.description: A detailed map of the volcanic region.

volcano-key.name: Volcano Gate Key
volcano-key.description: An heavy iron key with fiery runes.

hero.name: Alden
hero.description: A young hero seeking to save the kingdom.

scout.name: Boran the Scout
scout.description: A scout of the royal guard who knows the way inside.

dialogues.before_talk: Boran: The cold is worsening, but I cannot enter the volcano without my map. Find it in the village and I will trade you the Volcano Gate Key.
dialogues.after_talk: Boran: Have you found my map? Look near the village market stalls.
dialogues.after_satisfied: Boran: Perfect! Here is the Volcano Gate Key. Unlock the cave door and get inside.
dialogues.hostile: Boran: How dare you steal from the crown! Guards!
